record_hint: Use the MCP tools sim_record_decision, sim_record_impression, sim_record_vision_review, sim_record_reconcile, sim_record_read, sim_record_insight and sim_record_song_receipt (or `python -m sim record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with sim_records_search / sim_records_digest.
